title: YouCoded brand — round 22: initials raised, installer box polished

steps.headline: Keep the initials like this?
steps.changed: Your pick E (bigger letters, A's gradient on the "y"), with the letters moved up so they sit centred higher on the tile.
steps.notice: Shown big and at 48–16px on light and dark.

steps.headline: Keep the installer like this?
steps.changed: Your pick B, polished: the box, its flaps and its outline are now one drawing — the flaps grow out of the box's top corners, everything shares one outline colour and one shadow, and the download symbol is a touch bigger.
